retirements.title: Boiler-access portrait background
retirements.continuity: hotel_collection_slip_spotted: the player is still OUTSIDE the boiler door beside Lot 31 until the porter "opens the boiler-room door and ushers you through". B2-23 shows that exact spot (Lot 31, BOILER ACCESS door, collection stairs), so it is more truthful than B2-16, which looks out from inside the boiler access. The boiler-access MAIN scene (CH4-B2-13) is kept.
retirements.mechanism: Importer rule (game convert.js bgFor): a scene's own portraitBackground always wins and node backdrop is not an authorable field. Retirement therefore (1) moves the boiler_access#portraitBackground record and its public preview copy out of the active registry (record text, SHA-256 and pinned source preserved verbatim in docs/137 section 5 and git history; bytes stay at source commit 24c79bf) and (2) sets portraits[hotel_porter:alarmed].portraitBackgroundScene grand_bellevue/lobby -> grand_bellevue/service_passage. The lobby node hotel_chair_stapler_caught keeps the lobby background because the lobby scene has its own.

C1.title: Every node draws a scene image
C1.evidence: game/js/story-flow.js (main 3a8e07a) line 169 always calls G.setSceneArt for v.scene; convert.js reports a scene key with no record as a DEV PLACEHOLDER (an error in an approved build). Text-led exteriors therefore still need something in the scene aperture.
C1.smallestFallback: Game-side presentation rule: a node whose scene key is registered as text-led keeps the previous scene image (for the Chapter 4 opening that is Chapter 3's last image, which matches "You leave the People's Pavilion behind"). Needs a separately authorized engine change. Interim alternative with no engine work: reused records pointing arrival/forecourt at CH4-B2-06 loading lane and courtyard at CH4-B2-07 service alley. Not recommended: it adds movers and a sofa the text never mentions.

C2.title: A dialogue node must be led by a speaker with a portrait
C2.evidence: game/js/rules.js line 1788: "speaker X is an incidental voice (no portrait): it may only speak in say runs"; stage.js chapterArtKeys throws "No registered portrait for speaker". Incidental voices (docs/104 section 4) may only speak inside another speaker's conversation. Chapter 4 has 15 dialogue nodes led by the six portrait-less speakers (door AI 6, bathroom AI 4, lift voice 1, salvage clerk 2, guest 1, attendant 1).
C2.smallestFallback: Recommended: a generic engine extension so an incidental voice may lead a dialogue node, presented as Narrative B (no portrait aperture) with the voice's NAME: label (the docs/104 section 4 label machinery already exists). No canon or narrative change. Alternative (canon edit, needs approval): switch those 15 nodes to narrative mode with {say, who} runs, wording unchanged. Not recommended: produce 6 portraits and 5 backgrounds (11 images).

C3.title: Reuse cannot bind before the source art is integrated
C3.evidence: convert.js artRecord: a pending binding (runtime-settings pendingArtBindings) accepts only an "approved" record whose first notes SHA-256 equals the bound file. A "reused" record must carry a real art/ assetPath (the reception and wc_key precedent).
C3.smallestFallback: Register reuse as status "reused" with the source's art/ assetPath at integration time (existing mechanism, no new keys). Bixby commanding can instead change its node pose to delighted, like the retirements. Until then the storyboard records the reuse in docs/137 only.
